name: wb-lobster-memory
display_name: 龙虾长期图记忆（WorkBuddy 桥接）
description: WorkBuddy 接入 lobster-memory 长期图记忆的桥接技能。2026-09-11 起是 WorkBuddy 长期记忆的**唯一真源**（markdown 记忆层已清空为指针、身份文件已删除），用知识图谱（实体-关系-情绪 valence）记录用户的偏好、项目脉络与反馈，支持按需回忆与定期巩固遗忘。抽取 JSON 由 WorkBuddy 自身兼任 LLM 生成。
description_zh: WorkBuddy 接入 lobster-memory 长期图记忆的桥接技能。2026-09-11 起是 WorkBuddy 长期记忆的唯一真源（markdown 记忆层已清空为指针、身份文件已删除），用知识图谱（实体-关系-情绪 valence）记录用户偏好、项目脉络与反馈，支持按需回忆与定期巩固遗忘。
description_en: A WorkBuddy bridge skill for the lobster-memory long-term graph memory. Since 2026-09-11 it is the **single source of truth** for WorkBuddy's long-term memory (the markdown memory layer was emptied into pointers and the identity files deleted) — it records user preferences, project context, and feedback as a knowledge graph (entity-relation-emotion valence), with on-demand recall and periodic consolidation/forgetting. Extraction JSON is produced by WorkBuddy itself acting as the LLM.
author: Sai
